scope: Nine previously disabled control actions, through existing typed input, movement, weapon-drop and voice paths. Reference sources and commercial assets are not modified.

references.purpose: OnCommandOn/Off, UpdateCameraRotation and mouse input: RunLock, Strafe, TurnAround, Crosshair, held MouseAim and view-weapon idle admission.
UpdateControlFlags/UpdateMotion: held run lock, strafe-turn keys, mouse acceleration factors and clamp order.
Permanent MouseLook menu setting; retail row order.
CInputLine: 80-byte buffer, ASCII editing, Enter/Escape/Home/Backspace and message submission.
GrabObject eye ray (82), MOVEABLE gate, player displacement; DoTaunt VME_TAUNT; drop command and single-player text formatting.
DropCurrentWeapon single-player admission, live hand models, melee refusal, left-before-right detach and dropped-model ownership.
PlayEvent category cooldowns and original voice-group selection.

adaptations: Fresh-press TurnAround (one half-turn, no held retrigger), and Message on press rather than release.
SDL text events, 79 printable ASCII bytes, local single-player echo only; no multiplayer substitutions, network transport or cheat parser. Four transient HUD lines replace source surfaces.
Grab excludes its own player and uses the checked engine movement service.
No default bindings are added; all nine rows are assignable. Preferences version 11 stores auto-run, permanent mouse look and crosshair choices.
Existing player-drop synchronization and typed command routes replace original untyped messages. No weapon state machine, save payload or asset changes.
